[[Crafting material]]s are [[item]]s that can be used to [[craft]] (create) [[armor]], [[weapon]]s or [[Rare crafting material|rare materials]] in the game. Crafting is a service performed by [[crafter]] [[NPC]]s to whom you must pay [[gold]] and provide the necessary materials.

==Acquisition==
===[[Salvage]] and [[Loot]]===
Salvageable items are mostly obtained by killing mobs and opening chests, making Salvage and Loot somewhat interchangeable terms. Crafting materials are most commonly salvaged from [[weapons]], [[salvage item]]s, and [[Trophy|trophies]]; other sources include [[rare crafting material]]s and player [[armor]]. Many common crafting materials also drop frequently from certain types of monsters (e.g. Chitin Fragments from [[devourer]]s); see a particular material's article for details. Some rare crafting materials drop as well, although fewer creatures drop rare materials in [[Tyria]] than in [[Cantha]] or [[Elona]]. Most rare crafting materials can also be obtained from [[Hidden Treasure]]s.

===[[Material trader]]s and [[rare material trader]]s===
These [[NPC]]s sell crafting materials.

===[[Artisan]]s===
These [[NPC]]s can convert [[common crafting material]]s and gold into certain [[rare crafting material]]s.

==Trivia==
*[[Diamond]], [[Onyx Gemstone]], and [[Spiritwood Plank]] are the only crafting materials that cannot be used to craft [[armor]].
*Prior to the [[Game_updates/20080529#Miscellaneous|May 29, 2008 update]], some [[artisan]]s carried a recipe for a rare crafting material [[Clay Brick]]; however, there is no record of its common crafting material ingredient, [[Brick of Mud|Bricks of Mud]], ever being obtained, and there was no known use for either item. Neither were ever given a slot in the [[Vault Box#Materials|Xunlai materials storage]].
